title: Concept: JSF template error returned to a client
description: A JSF template error with its file and line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message names the view and the expression binding, which is a direct look at the server-side expression language used on the page.
applicability: Deployments that render a JSF template error with its file and line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message names the view and the expression binding, which is a direct look at the server-side expression language used on the page.
